purpose: Teach: セッティング/余剰/履行/教委/当人/民放/窃盗/終値

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場のセッティングを再現しております
lines.en: We're reconstructing the scene as it was found.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Even tone with no inflection. Methodical pace. The voice of someone stating fact without editorializing. Direct eye contact maintained.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、余剰の証拠も整理されているとのこと
lines.en: Yes. I understand the evidence has been catalogued and organized.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with slight formal distance. Clear, steady delivery. Light pause before the second clause, showing attentiveness to what's being said. Collaborative but not presumptuous.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、約束の履行を市民に求めております
lines.en: We're asking citizens to uphold their part of the agreement.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Weight on the word 'asking'—it carries both expectation and respect. Measured pace. The tone of someone whose authority comes from clarity, not volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、教委と連携防犯活動、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the police coordination with the school board on crime prevention.
lines.style: Sincere appreciation in the voice. Slight warmth breaking through formality. Steady delivery that shows genuine relief at institutional cooperation. Not flattering—genuine respect.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑当人と直接対話されました
lines.en: We've spoken directly with the suspect.
lines.style: Factual, slightly weighted on the past tense. No emotion attached to the statement itself. Clinical precision. Brief and complete—nothing more needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、民放での発信も効果的ですね
lines.en: Yes. The media coverage has been quite effective in getting the word out.
lines.style: Agreement that understands the strategy. Light lift at 'effective'—acknowledging a successful tactic. Warm but professional. The tone of someone who sees how the pieces fit together.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、窃盗事件を集中捜査しております
lines.en: We're conducting an intensive investigation into the theft.
lines.style: Steady resolve. Weight on 'intensive'—showing the seriousness of the effort. No hurried pace, but urgent undertone. The voice of someone committed to resolution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事件の終値推移を警察、確認されているそうですね
lines.en: Yes. I understand you've verified the timeline of the case as it developed.
lines.style: Quiet precision. Shows Kenji has been listening carefully. Slight leaning-in quality, showing engagement with the procedural details. Respectful closure—the voice of someone who trusts what's been done.
